_comment: Machine-readable declaration of the required status checks for `main`, applied as a REPOSITORY RULESET by enforce-branch-protection.yml on every push to main that touches it (CI-1 Phase 1, ledger `2026-10-12-ci1-post-merge-stamp`: classic branch protection moved to a ruleset whose sole bypass actor is the Ledger Stamp GitHub App). To add a new required check: (1) add it to CI_GATES.md Tier 1 table, (2) add the exact status context string here, (3) add the required-check comment block to the workflow YAML.

ruleset.name: main — required status checks
ruleset._bypass: The only bypass actor is the Ledger Stamp GitHub App, read from the repository variable LEDGER_STAMP_APP_ID (actor_type Integration, bypass_mode always). No other actor is ever added here.

review_ruleset.name: Protect main (review + checks + no force-push/delete)
review_ruleset._comment: The review ruleset on main (bypass: admins in pull-request mode, plus the Ledger Stamp App). It is matched by ID, so a rename does not lose it (its live name still ends "+ no force-push/delete" although those rules moved out on Oct 13, 2026). The enforcer sets ONLY the pull_request rule's require_last_push_approval to the value below and verifies it; every other rule, parameter and bypass actor is sent back as read. It REFUSES, before any write, if this ruleset carries a deletion or non_fast_forward rule: those live only in no_force_push_ruleset and are never re-added here (decision-maker, Oct 14, 2026).

no_force_push_ruleset.name: main — no force-push/delete
no_force_push_ruleset._comment: Force-push and deletion protection for main lives ONLY here, with NO bypass actor of any kind — not admins, not the Ledger Stamp App (decision-maker, Oct 14, 2026; ledger `2026-10-14-ci1-ruleset-split`). The enforcer READS it and asserts it exists, is active, has exactly the rules below and an empty bypass list; it never writes it. A failed assertion fails the run, and the fix is a human in Settings → Rules, never the enforcer.

contexts: suite-mutation-auth (server/__tests__/mutation-auth — live authorization probes, DB + app)
unit-suite-server-units (server utils · seeds · travelpayouts · trend-engine — whole dirs)
guard-batch (26 grep/logic guards — each a named step)
traveler-charge-composition (docs/ROADMAP.md §A A3 — the commission is never billed to the buyer)
slip-card-integrity (slip is live, finalized plan is not re-routed, expert must exist)
legacy-rail-traveler-charge (2026-09-08-legacy-rail-fee — the same fix on the legacy rail)
acceptance-rails (D-24..D-27, D-32..D-40; four ledgers, see comment)
